text: 工业和信息化部产业政策与法规司编制形成《工业和信息化部关于修改部分规章的决定（征求意见稿）》，拟修改《道路机动车辆生产企业及产品准入管理办法》《新能源汽车生产企业及产品准入管理规定》《通信建设工程质量监督管理规定》《〈中华人民共和国监控化学品管理条例〉实施细则》《无线电频率使用许可管理办法》《业余无线电台管理办法》等6部规章的部分条款。
text_en: The Department of Industrial Policy and Regulations of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has drafted the "Decision of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on Amending Certain Rules (Draft for Comment)," proposing to amend some provisions of six rules, including the "Measures for the Administration of Access of Road Motor Vehicle Manufacturing Enterprises and Products," the "Provisions on the Administration of Access of New Energy Vehicle Manufacturing Enterprises and Products," the "Provisions on the Supervision and Administration of the Quality of Communications Construction Projects," the "Implementation Rules for the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Controlled Chemicals," the "Measures for the Administration of Radio Frequency Use Licensing," and the "Measures for the Administration of Amateur Radio Stations."
